declarations.description: Signed translation of one item or passage, shown in the host's content-media surface. The sign-language registration's `renderSurface` mounts it and sets `media` to a resolved catalog card; it plays that recording muted with native controls, held to the card's authored time slice, under a caption naming the sign language. Its playback and read-aloud through the toolkit runtime context's TTS service pause each other.
declarations.name: SignLanguageMediaRegion

members.name: i18n
members.description: Interface-locale provider, supplied by the host surface. Absent, the English-only default names the language rather than leaking a key.

attributes.name: i18n
attributes.description: Interface-locale provider, supplied by the host surface. Absent, the English-only default names the language rather than leaking a key.

cssProperties.name: --pie-section-player-item-media-aspect-ratio
cssProperties.description: Public sizing hook for the item card media region; defaults to 3 / 4 because signed content needs height for hands and face. Geometry-only, but hosts must keep signing legible when overriding.

cssProperties.name: --pie-section-player-item-media-max-height
cssProperties.description: Public ceiling for the item card media region; defaults to 60vh so a tall recording cannot push question content off screen. Geometry-only.

cssProperties.name: --pie-section-player-item-media-min-height
cssProperties.description: Public legibility floor for the item card media region; defaults to 220px so a narrow content column cannot crush signed content. Geometry-only.
